summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K attaching a UK TR-1 notification of major holdings. Dodge & Cox reported that its aggregate voting rights in GSK fell from 5.01% to 4.96% as of June 24, 2026, crossing the 5% threshold downwards. No acquisition or disposition by the issuer occurred; this is a routine passive stake disclosure by a large asset manager. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic actions. This filing does not represent a special situation.
